items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: But she wasn't singing with the band, she was the number one headline. His band had the show, and she was my sister-in-law.

ctx.x: But she wasn't singing with the band, she was the number one headline. His band had the show, and she was my sister-in-law.

When you first ran into Raeburn, at that point Eddie was writing for the band, the first phase, and who else; do you remember who had contributed some stuff? Harry Klee wrote some things, it seems to me.
